text: His upper body rests steadily against the support of the couch, stretched out with both shoulders gently bowed. With his two palms upturned and placed, he resembles a fully bloomed lotus in the center of his lap. A snake is tied to his mass of matted hair, and double-stringed rudraksha beads adorn his ears. He wears a knotted dark skin that appears specially blue against the radiance of his neck.
